recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The extension definition remains deprecated/retired in the Extension Pack, core no longer depends on the deprecated extension, and implementers still see the fhir-types generated/normative warning.
issue_request: FHIR-40706 was Applied/Persuasive and requested clarification of valueset-special-status; the approved Vocabulary resolution was to deprecate the extension because no use was identified.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-40706. The extension definition was moved/applied in the FHIR Extension Pack, where it is deprecated, retired, and carries a deprecation rationale, but current core still used the extension on source/terminologies/codesystem-fhir-types.xml.
additional_context: Terminology Infrastructure minutes confirm the FHIR-40706 deprecation vote and scoped codesystem-workflowStatus to separate follow-up work, later represented by FHIR-45254 in the Extension Pack. Zulip context showed the fhir-types warning was useful to explain generated normative terminology whose contents can change across FHIR versions.
reconciliation: Changed source/terminologies/codesystem-fhir-types.xml to remove the valueset-special-status extension instance and move its warning into the standard CodeSystem.description field. The source/oids.ini canonical/OID record was left unchanged because it is a registry entry, not an active use.
